comment:
* Utility class for image analysis and processing.
 *
 * @hide

variables.name: TOLERANCE
variables.comment: Amount (max is 255) that two channels can differ before the color is no longer "gray".

variables.name: ALPHA_TOLERANCE
variables.comment: Alpha amount for which values below are considered transparent.

methods.name: public boolean isGrayscale(Bitmap bitmap)
methods.comment:
* Checks whether a bitmap is grayscale. Grayscale here means "very close to a perfect
     * gray".
     *
     * Instead of scanning every pixel in the bitmap, we first resize the bitmap to no more than
     * COMPACT_BITMAP_SIZE^2 pixels using filtering. The hope is that any non-gray color elements
     * will survive the squeezing process, contaminating the result with color.

methods.name: private void ensureBufferSize(int size)
methods.comment: * Makes sure that {@code mTempBuffer} has at least length {@code size}.

methods.name: public static boolean isGrayscale(int color)
methods.comment:
* Classifies a color as grayscale or not. Grayscale here means "very close to a perfect
     * gray"; if all three channels are approximately equal, this will return true.
     *
     * Note that really transparent colors are always grayscale.

methods.name: public static Bitmap buildScaledBitmap(Drawable drawable, int maxWidth, int maxHeight)
methods.comment: * Convert a drawable to a bitmap, scaled to fit within maxWidth and maxHeight.

methods.name: public static Bitmap buildScaledBitmap(Drawable drawable, int maxWidth, int maxHeight, boolean allowUpscaling)
methods.comment:
* Convert a drawable to a bitmap, scaled to fit within maxWidth and maxHeight.
     *
     * @param allowUpscaling if true, the drawable will not only be scaled down, but also scaled up
     *                       to fit within the maximum size given. This is useful for converting
     *                       vectorized icons which usually have a very small intrinsic size.

methods.name: public static int calculateSampleSize(Size currentSize, Size requestedSize)
public static Bitmap loadThumbnail(ContentResolver resolver, Uri uri, Size size) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Load a bitmap, and attempt to downscale to the required size, to save
     * on memory. Updated to use newer and more compatible ImageDecoder.
     *
     * @see https://developer.android.com/topic/performance/graphics/load-bitmap
